description: Targeted Richardson extraction of the 4₁ Kashaev leading 1/N coefficient κ₁ (the observable action coeff) + PSLQ over ℚ(√3)·π^j; decisive test of whether κ₁ has an exact real-cyclotomic closed form.

result.verdict: IDENTIFIED (scope: 4₁ classical Ohtsuki asymptotics). The observable even-channel leading coefficient κ₁ = [1/N] log J_N(4₁), extracted to ≈23 confident digits (10-point Vandermonde, N≤786432; matches the #3571 numerically-fitted c₁≈0.554), is EXACTLY κ₁ = 11·√3·π/108 ∈ ℚ(√3)·π (2-term PSLQ [q,p]=(-108, -11), 33-digit agreement). Two structural facts: (1) κ₁ = (11/2)·b₁ — the Euler–Maclaurin sum-vs-integral correction multiplies the naive integral-Laplace saddle b₁=√3π/54 (Lean #3606) by exactly 11/2; (2) the Ohtsuki imaginary-coefficient form κ_1^Oht = A/√−3 has A = 11/72 exactly — the classical figure-eight 2-loop numerator '11'. This CLOSES the exact value of the even-channel action's leading coefficient (which #3571's full-ladder PSLQ was entropy-blocked on and the naive saddle missed). SCOPE (anti-laundering): this is a fact about the 4₁ Kashaev/Ohtsuki asymptotic — NOT a Q_β production c_k. The bridge (Q_β observable action ≡ 4₁ resurgence action) remains the open keystone; nothing is wired, no tier changes.
